list.name: enterprise
list.label: Enterprise
list.query: SELECT nm_enterprise AS __text, id_enterprise AS __value FROM enterprises ORDER BY nm_enterprise

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT nm_site AS __text, id_site AS __value FROM sites WHERE id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) ORDER BY nm_site

list.name: area
list.label: Area
list.query: SELECT nm_area AS __text, id_area AS __value FROM areas WHERE id_site IN ($site) ORDER BY nm_area

list.name: equipment
list.label: Equipment
list.query: SELECT nm_equipment AS __text, id_equipment AS __value FROM equipments WHERE id_area IN ($area) ORDER BY nm_equipment

options.content:
### OEE per equipment — SQL over `equipment_values`
Availability × Performance × Quality, computed **in SQL directly from raw `equipment_values`** and scoped by the **$enterprise → $site → $area → $equipment** chain. This is a hand-rolled business view for the selected time window — it does **not** read the engine's authoritative `production_orders_runtime` / `equipment_runtime_*` aggregates. Cross-check against those tables; small disagreements are expected because the engine buckets by shift/PO while this rolls up raw ticks over the picker window.

panels.title: OEE %
panels.description: Availability × Performance × Quality over the selected window, computed in SQL from raw equipment_values. World-class ≥ 85%. NOTE: this is a raw-tick roll-up — the engine's authoritative OEE lives in production_orders_runtime / equipment_runtime_*; cross-check there, minor drift is expected.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, ROUND( ( (SUM(ev.net_production_incr) / NULLIF(SUM(ev.net_production_incr) + SUM(ev.scrap_incr), 0)) * (SUM(CASE WHEN ev.speed > 0 THEN ev.speed ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ev.speed > 0 THEN COALESCE(e.ideal_speed, e.production_speed) ELSE 0 END), 0)) * (SUM(CASE WHEN ev.state = 6 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100 )::numeric, 1) AS "OEE %" FROM equipment_values ev JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment = ev.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(ev.ts_value) AND ev.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND ev.id_site IN ($site) AND ev.id_area IN ($area) AND ev.id_equipment IN ($equipment) AND ev.net_production_incr IS NOT NULL AND ev.state IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(e.ideal_speed, e.production_speed) > 0

panels.title: Availability %
panels.description: Fraction of reporting ticks in Execute state (state=6), in SQL over equipment_values. Target ≥ 90%. Cross-check against the engine's equipment_runtime_* availability.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, ROUND( (SUM(CASE WHEN state = 6 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "Availability %" FROM equipment_values WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_value) AND id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND id_site IN ($site) AND id_area IN ($area) AND id_equipment IN ($equipment) AND state IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Performance %
panels.description: Avg actual speed / ideal_speed (from equipments), in SQL over equipment_values. Target ≥ 95%. Cross-check against the engine's equipment_runtime_* performance.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, ROUND( (SUM(ev.speed) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(e.ideal_speed, e.production_speed)), 0) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "Performance %" FROM equipment_values ev JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment = ev.id_equipment WHERE $__timeFilter(ev.ts_value) AND ev.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND ev.id_site IN ($site) AND ev.id_area IN ($area) AND ev.id_equipment IN ($equipment) AND ev.speed > 0 AND COALESCE(e.ideal_speed, e.production_speed) > 0

panels.title: Quality %
panels.description: Net / (Net + Scrap) over the selected window, in SQL over equipment_values. Target ≥ 98%. Cross-check against the engine's production_orders_runtime net/gross.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, ROUND( (SUM(net_production_incr) / NULLIF(SUM(net_production_incr) + SUM(scrap_incr), 0) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "Quality %" FROM equipment_values WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_value) AND id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND id_site IN ($site) AND id_area IN ($area) AND id_equipment IN ($equipment) AND net_production_incr IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Total rows ingested
panels.description: COUNT(*) of equipment_values for the scoped hierarchy (all time).

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Total Rows" FROM equipment_values WHERE id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND id_site IN ($site) AND id_area IN ($area) AND id_equipment IN ($equipment)

panels.title: Rows (last 5 min)
panels.description: equipment_values rows written in the last 5 minutes — a heartbeat. 0 = no ingest.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Rows/5min" FROM equipment_values WHERE id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND id_site IN ($site) AND id_area IN ($area) AND id_equipment IN ($equipment) AND ts_value > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'

panels.title: Last message
panels.description: MAX(ts_value) for the scoped hierarchy — how fresh the data is.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(ts_value)) * 1000 AS "Last Message" FROM equipment_values WHERE id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND id_site IN ($site) AND id_area IN ($area) AND id_equipment IN ($equipment)

panels.title: Active PLC registrations
panels.description: packml_register rows with active=true for the scoped hierarchy — topics oeecloud will route.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Active" FROM packml_register WHERE active = true AND id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND id_site IN ($site) AND id_area IN ($area) AND id_equipment IN ($equipment)

panels.title: Production count — net_production_incr
panels.description: Incremental production count per message, per equipment (SUM over $__interval buckets).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ev.ts_value, $__interval), ent.nm_enterprise || ' › ' || e.nm_equipment AS metric, SUM(ev.net_production_incr) FROM equipment_values ev JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment = ev.id_equipment JOIN enterprises ent ON ent.id_enterprise = ev.id_enterprise WHERE $__timeFilter(ev.ts_value) AND ev.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND ev.id_site IN ($site) AND ev.id_area IN ($area) AND ev.id_equipment IN ($equipment) AND ev.net_production_incr IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ev.ts_value, $__interval), ent.nm_enterprise || ' › ' || e.nm_equipment AS metric, AVG(ev.speed) FROM equipment_values ev JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment = ev.id_equipment JOIN enterprises ent ON ent.id_enterprise = ev.id_enterprise WHERE $__timeFilter(ev.ts_value) AND ev.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND ev.id_site IN ($site) AND ev.id_area IN ($area) AND ev.id_equipment IN ($equipment) AND ev.speed IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ev.ts_value, $__interval), ent.nm_enterprise || ' › ' || e.nm_equipment AS metric, SUM(ev.scrap_incr) FROM equipment_values ev JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment = ev.id_equipment JOIN enterprises ent ON ent.id_enterprise = ev.id_enterprise WHERE $__timeFilter(ev.ts_value) AND ev.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND ev.id_site IN ($site) AND ev.id_area IN ($area) AND ev.id_equipment IN ($equipment) AND ev.scrap_incr IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Machine state (PackML StateCurrent)
panels.description: LAST(state) per equipment per bucket. 6 = Running (green), 10 = Stopped (red).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ev.ts_value, $__interval), ent.nm_enterprise || ' › ' || e.nm_equipment AS metric, LAST(ev.state, ev.ts_value) FROM equipment_values ev JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment = ev.id_equipment JOIN enterprises ent ON ent.id_enterprise = ev.id_enterprise WHERE $__timeFilter(ev.ts_value) AND ev.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND ev.id_site IN ($site) AND ev.id_area IN ($area) AND ev.id_equipment IN ($equipment) AND ev.state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest equipment_values (last 50 rows)
panels.description: Raw tail of equipment_values for the scoped hierarchy — the ground truth the OEE stats above are computed from.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ev.ts_value, ent.nm_enterprise AS enterprise, s.nm_site AS site, a.nm_area AS area, e.nm_equipment AS equipment, ev.net_production_incr, ev.gross_production_incr, ev.scrap_incr, ev.state, ev.mode, ev.speed, ev.signal_quality FROM equipment_values ev JOIN equipments e ON e.id_equipment = ev.id_equipment JOIN areas a ON a.id_area = ev.id_area JOIN sites s ON s.id_site = ev.id_site JOIN enterprises ent ON ent.id_enterprise = ev.id_enterprise WHERE ev.id_enterprise IN ($enterprise) AND ev.id_site IN ($site) AND ev.id_area IN ($area) AND ev.id_equipment IN ($equipment) ORDER BY ev.ts_value DESC LIMIT 50
